name: DreamOS release signing (key mounted read-only)
script:
set -x
# Signing step: the only container that gets the release key (read-only at /secrets). Input = an unsigned dreamos build run (/in, read-only).
# Params (env): VERSION (as built), CHANNEL (a test channel while testing), KEYID (default ruiko-1).
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
cd /work/src
[ -d /in ] && [ -n "${VERSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${CHANNEL:-}" ] || { echo "need input run, VERSION and CHANNEL"; exit 2; }
[[ "$CHANNEL" == test* ]] || [ "${ALLOW_REAL_CHANNEL:-}" = yes-yukimi-said-so ] || { echo "refusing channel $CHANNEL: only test* channels without ALLOW_REAL_CHANNEL"; exit 3; }
KEYID=${KEYID:-ruiko-1}
bc=$(sed -n 's/.*"commit":"\([0-9a-f]*\)".*/\1/p' /in/build-info.json)
[ "$bc" = "$RACK_COMMIT" ] || { echo "checkout $RACK_COMMIT is not the built commit $bc (use ref=$bc)"; exit 4; }
(cd /in && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
mkdir -p out cafeready/target/release /out
for n in root.raw root-verity.raw efi recovery.efi hw-full.raw; do cp --sparse=always /in/dreamos_$VERSION.$n out/dreamos_$VERSION.$n; done
cp /in/cafeready cafeready/target/release/cafeready
DREAMOS_SIGNING_KEY=/secrets/release-$KEYID.pem DREAMOS_KEYID=$KEYID tools/release.sh "$VERSION" "$CHANNEL"
mkdir -p /out/release && cp release/$CHANNEL.* /out/release/
(cd /out/release && sha256sum $CHANNEL.json $CHANNEL.sig > SHA256SUMS)
# the manifest as shipped, verifiable with the public key in the image
openssl pkey -in /secrets/release-$KEYID.pem -pubout > /tmp/pub.pem
base64 -d < release/$CHANNEL.sig > /tmp/sig.bin && openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey /tmp/pub.pem -rawin -in release/$CHANNEL.json -sigfile /tmp/sig.bin
cp image/mkosi.extra/usr/lib/dreamos/release-keys/$KEYID.pem /tmp/trusted.pem && cmp <(openssl pkey -pubin -in /tmp/trusted.pem -outform DER) <(openssl pkey -pubin -in /tmp/pub.pem -outform DER) && echo "[rack] signature verifies with the image's trusted $KEYID key"
